column1: # Third-party agent skills. This is the source of truth for bin/install-skills.
#   ref     branch, tag or commit to check out ("main", "master", or a SHA to pin)
#   path    directory inside the repository that holds SKILL.md ("." = repo root)
# Skill CONTENT is deliberately not vendored here. bin/install-skills fetches
# each repository at the given ref and copies only the skill directory into
# ~/.agents/skills/<name>, then runs bin/sync-agent-skills to refresh the
# Pin a row by replacing its ref with a commit SHA. bin/install-skills records
# the resolved SHA of every install in ~/.agents/third-party-skills.tsv, which
# is generated state and is not tracked.
